data.title: The month-end ledger

memoryNodes.cue: The May plan still needs checking.

data.situation:
At the end of April, Mina carried the sales ledger upstairs. The shop’s turnover for the month was £2,400. Jay smiled at the figure until Mina placed the costs beside it. Materials, wages, rent and the other listed expenses came to £2,500, leaving a deficit of £100 for the month. Turnover was the amount earned from sales before those costs, not the money Mina could take home. The next page contained a smaller forecast for May. If the expected sales and costs were right, there would be a surplus of £150. Jay closed the notebook halfway and asked what happened if the forecast was wrong. Mina opened it again. They would write the actual figures beside the plan when the month was over. APRIL — SHOP LEDGER
Turnover: £2,400.
All recorded costs: £2,500.
Result: £100 deficit.
MAY — PLAN ONLY
Expected sales: £2,600. Expected costs: £2,450.
Expected net profit after all listed costs: £150.
Actual figures: leave blank until the month ends.

readingBlocks.zh: 四月底，米娜把销售账本带到楼上。当月小店营业额是 2400 英镑。杰伊看到数字笑了，直到米娜把成本放到旁边。材料、工资、房租和其他列出的支出共 2500 英镑，留下当月 100 英镑的赤字。营业额是减去这些费用之前的销售收入，不是米娜可以拿回家的钱。下一页有一份五月的简短预测。如果预计收入和支出准确，就会有 150 英镑盈余。杰伊把本子合到一半，问预测错了怎么办。米娜又打开本子，等月底再把实际数字写在计划旁。

All recorded costs: £2,500.

Expected sales: £2,600. Expected costs: £2,450.

readingBlocks.zh:
四月——店铺账本
营业额：2400 英镑。
全部已记录成本：2500 英镑。
结果：100 英镑赤字。
五月——仅为计划
预计销售额：2600 英镑。预计成本：2450 英镑。
扣除全部列出成本后的预计净利润：150 英镑。
实际数字：月底再填写。

glossary.zh: 一定时期内的销售营业额
glossary.note: 英式商业用法：营业额是销售收入，未扣成本；与 staff turnover 员工流动不同。
glossary.example: The shop’s monthly turnover was twenty-four hundred pounds.
glossary.exampleZh: 小店月营业额是两千四百英镑。

glossary.zh: 扣除相关费用后的净额的
glossary.note: net profit：净利润；net weight：不含包装等的净重。
glossary.example: The expected net profit was one hundred and fifty pounds.
glossary.exampleZh: 预计净利润是一百五十英镑。

glossary.zh: 支出超过收入的差额；赤字
glossary.note: a deficit of + 金额：赤字；支出超过收入的差额。
glossary.example: April ended with a deficit of one hundred pounds.
glossary.exampleZh: 四月出现一百英镑赤字。
